The next few hours go by so quickly it’s like they never happened in the first place.
lines.zh: 接下来的几个小时过得飞快，快得像是从一开始就不曾存在过。

lines.en: And, you know...maybe they didn’t.
lines.zh: 而且，你知道吗……也许它们确实不曾存在过。

lines.en: But as I step back outside to get on with the rest of the night, I imagine a world in which they did.
lines.zh: 但当我重新走到室外、继续这一夜剩下的部分时，我却在想象一个它们确实存在过的世界。

lines.en: And then I think about how many people I’d need to hurt in order to get there.
lines.zh: 然后我开始想，要走到那一步，我得伤害多少人。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky

As I mentioned in the very beginning, there was no way this trip was going to end without some semblance of seriousness. And with the sun merely hours away from rising, it appears I can no longer avoid that.
lines.zh: 正如我最开始所说，这趟旅行绝不可能不带一点正经意味地收场。而距离太阳升起只剩短短几个小时，看来我再也无法回避了。

lines.en: The two of us move through a maze of white beach chairs and brightly colored umbrellas to an opening halfway between pools number four and five.
lines.zh: 我们两个穿过由白色沙滩椅和色彩鲜艳的遮阳伞组成的迷宫，来到四号池和五号池之间的一处空地。

lines.en: I didn’t understand how they were numbered earlier, but it didn’t take very long to figure out once I had a little more time to focus on them.
lines.zh: 我之前不明白这些池子是怎么编号的，但稍微多花点时间留意之后，没多久就搞清楚了。

lines.en: It’s like that for most things, I find.
lines.zh: 我发现，大多数事情都是这样。

lines.en: Everything is confusing at first — from the way the body works to the manner in which moonlight can reflect off of nearly everything it touches.
lines.zh: 一切在最初都是令人困惑的——从身体的运作方式，到月光如何在它触碰到的几乎一切事物上反光。

lines.en: Granted, both of those things would likely still confuse me if you were to sit down and carefully explain them, but what I’m trying to say is there will {i}always{/i} be aspects of life that just don’t click for us.
lines.zh: 诚然，就算你坐下来仔仔细细给我解释，这两样东西大概还是会让我犯迷糊——但我想说的是，生活里{i}总{/i}有一些面向，是怎么也跟我们对不上频的。

lines.en: For me, the most glaring issue of all is figuring out a way to circumvent how I really feel and properly disguise myself as a good person.
lines.zh: 对我来说，最刺眼的那个问题，就是想办法绕开自己真实的感受，把自己好好伪装成一个好人。

lines.en: For Maki, the problem is much simpler.
lines.zh: 而对 Maki 来说，问题要简单得多。

lines.en: She just doesn’t give herself enough credit.
lines.zh: 她只是不肯给自己足够的肯定。

lines.en: And if I had to take a guess, it would be that this has something to do with that as well.
lines.zh: 如果非要我猜的话，眼下这事恐怕也和这一点有关。

lines.en: scene makiclearnight1
Or...maybe I’m wrong.
lines.zh: 又或者……是我想错了。

lines.en: That’s not the look of someone who’s battling depressing inner-turmoil or...questioning the methods they’ve used to navigate through mazes far more complex than ones full of chairs and parasols.
lines.zh: 那可不是一副正在与压抑的内心挣扎、或是在质疑自己穿越迷宫之法的神情——那些迷宫远比塞满椅子和遮阳伞的迷宫要复杂得多。

lines.en: To be honest, I don’t really {i}know{/i} what that look is.
lines.zh: 说实话，我真不{i}知道{/i}那是什么神情。

lines.en: And for someone who spends so much time deciding how people feel before they’re able to tell me, that’s a little surprising.
lines.zh: 对于一个总在别人开口之前就替他们决定了心情的人来说，这还挺让人意外的。

lines.en: Again, it’s only a matter of hours until the sun begins to rise — and that’s not enough time to learn everything there is to know about Maki.
lines.zh: 再说一次，太阳升起只剩几个小时了——而这点时间，不足以让我了解关于 Maki 的一切。

lines.en: But it’s enough to figure out whatever it is that infiltrated her mind and planted itself within her most identifiable quality.
lines.zh: 但足够我弄清楚，究竟是什么东西渗进了她的脑子里，并且扎根在她最鲜明的那个特质之中。

lines.en: I just don’t like watching her rot from the inside out, and if there is something I can do to stop it-
lines.zh: 我只是不想看着她由内而外地腐烂——如果有什么是我能做的、能阻止这件事的话……

lines.en: : Have you noticed anything different about Makoto lately?
lines.zh: : 你最近有觉得 Makoto 有什么不一样吗？

lines.en: I might have to just look the other way.
lines.zh: 也许我只能把目光移向别处。

lines.en: : Something tells me we've been here before.
lines.zh: : 有种感觉告诉我，我们以前来过这儿。

lines.en: : Something tells me you're right.
lines.zh: : 有种感觉告诉我，你是对的。

lines.en: : Maki, I’m not really sure I should be getting any further involved in anything that goes on between you and Makoto. It never really goes the way we want it to.
lines.zh: : Maki，我真不确定自己该不该更深地卷进你和她之间发生的任何事。它从来都不会按我们想要的方向走。

lines.en: : Not even if it’s good this time?
lines.zh: : 就算这次是好事也不行？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : I’m talking about how she’s been pretty great lately. She’s not sulking or sleeping in or anything like that. She seems to be genuinely enjoying herself.
lines.zh: : 我是说她最近状态挺好的。她不再闷闷不乐，也不赖床什么的了。她看起来是真的在享受生活。

lines.en: Or at least doing an exceptional job of pretending to.
lines.zh: 或者至少，她装得格外好。

lines.en: : If...that’s what you’re talking about, then yes. I have noticed. I can’t imagine that’s what you called me out here to talk about, though.
lines.zh: : 如果……你说的是这个，那没错，我注意到了。不过我很难想象，你把我叫出来就是为了聊这个。

lines.en: scene makiclearnight2
: It is and it isn’t.
lines.zh: : 是，也不是。

lines.en: : It’s no secret that I may have sidelined my own feelings when my husband died so Makoto wouldn’t be {i}completely{/i} without a parental figure, but...
lines.zh: : 我丈夫去世的时候，我大概是把自己的情绪搁到了一边，好让 Makoto 不至于{i}完全{/i}没有父母的角色——这也不是什么秘密，只是……

lines.en: : Now that she’s fine...I don’t know. Maybe all those feelings I didn’t have time to {i}feel{/i} are catching up to me or something. There’s a lot going on, but none of it is really {i}bad.{/i}
lines.zh: : 既然她现在没事了……我不知道。也许那些我当初没时间去{i}感受{/i}的情绪，现在都找上门来了吧。发生的事情很多，但没有一件是真的{i}糟糕{/i}。

lines.en: : I’m just confused, I guess. About where to go from here and who I’m supposed to be and what I’m supposed to feel or...do.
lines.zh: : 我只是很困惑吧，我猜。困惑接下来该往哪走、我该成为什么样的人、我该有什么样的感受，或者……做些什么。

lines.en: : So...are you saying stress or...grief or something really {i}is{/i} what’s making you all...non-Maki?
lines.zh: : 所以……你是说，压力或者……悲伤之类的东西，{i}真的就是{/i}让你变得这么……不像 Maki 的原因？

lines.en: : It’s definitely not helping, I’ll tell you that much.
lines.zh: : 这点我可以说：它绝对没起好作用。

lines.en: scene clearnightsky
: Despite how it might seem basically all the time, I {i}am{/i} an adult at the end of the day. And I can figure out ways to deal with stress and all that other lame adult stuff.
lines.zh: : 尽管基本上看起来一直都不是那么回事，但说到底我{i}是{/i}个成年人。我总能找到办法应对压力，还有那些无聊的大人烦恼。

lines.en: : I’ve been stressed {i}plenty{/i} of times in my life, and it’s never had this effect on me before. But...
lines.zh: : 我这辈子压力大的时候{i}多了去了{/i}，从来没对我产生过这种影响。可是……

lines.en: : There’s been something bothering me lately. Something that I’ve {i}never{/i} had to deal with. And, despite all of the experience in the world, I have no idea what to do about it.
lines.zh: : 最近有件事一直困扰着我。一件我{i}从来没有{/i}应付过的事。而且，就算我有全世界的经验，我也不知道该拿它怎么办。

lines.en: : And that is...somehow centered around Makoto’s happiness?
lines.zh: : 而那件事……不知怎么，是围绕着 Makoto 的幸福的？

lines.en: scene makiclearnight3
: I know it probably sounds weird, but...{i}yeah.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我知道听起来大概很奇怪，不过……{i}是的{/i}。

lines.en: : She’s never been {i}this{/i} happy before. And the timing of it all is just really confusing to me since her dad hasn’t even been gone all that long.
lines.zh: : 她从来没有{i}这么{/i}快乐过。而这一切的时机也让我很困惑，因为她爸爸才刚走没多久。

lines.en: : Like, I’m not hoping she goes back to being miserable. I’m over the moon that she can get out of bed on her own now. I just think there’s...something else to this.
lines.zh: : 就是说，我不是盼着她重新变回那个痛苦的样子。她现在能自己起床了，我高兴得都要上天了。我只是觉得……这里面还有别的东西。

lines.en: : I know her well enough to understand that there’s no way this level of glee would ever come naturally. And so...I think there’s something {i}else{/i} that’s making her happy.
lines.zh: : 我足够了解她，明白这种程度的喜悦不可能凭空自然产生。所以……我觉得是有{i}别的{/i}东西在让她快乐。

lines.en: : Why not just accept whatever that is, then? There’s no need to bash your head against the wall trying to figure it out when you should just be happy {i}for{/i} her.
lines.zh: : 那为什么不干脆接受那件东西是什么？你本该{i}替{/i}她高兴的，没必要拿头撞墙非要弄个明白。

lines.en: : What I’m saying is I think she’s having sex.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我觉得她在做爱了。

lines.en: : At the very least, she probably has a boyfriend or something. But the weirdest part of all of it is that I, Maki Miyamura, the sex queen of the city-
lines.zh: : 至少，她大概交了男朋友之类的。但整件事里最奇怪的是，我，Maki Miyamura，这座城市的性爱女王——

lines.en: : Have absolutely no idea how to talk to her about it...
lines.zh: : 却完全不知道该怎么跟她开口谈这件事……

lines.en: : It’s crazy, isn’t it? You’d think that if {i}anyone{/i} could talk to their daughter about this, it would be me. I even had a dry run during that Dorm Wars thingy.
lines.zh: : 很疯狂吧？换作谁都会觉得，如果{i}有人{/i}能跟自己女儿谈这个，那一定是我。我甚至在那个「宿舍战争」之类的活动里预演过一次。

lines.en: : I’ve been preparing for it for...basically {i}forever{/i} since I knew this day would come.
lines.zh: : 我为此准备了……基本上是{i}一辈子{/i}，因为我知道这一天迟早会来。

lines.en: : But now that it’s here...I’m lost. I have no idea what to say to her. I feel totally useless in my very own area of expertise.
lines.zh: : 可现在它真的来了……我却迷失了。我完全不知道该对她说什么。在我自己最擅长的领域里，我感觉自己一无是处。

lines.en: : Now, any time I think about sex at all, I just start thinking about her. And I’m sure I don’t have to tell you why that hasn’t really been working out for me.
lines.zh: : 现在，只要我一想到性，就会开始想起她。而我想也不必多说，你应该明白这对我的状态为什么一直没起好作用。

lines.en: : You want to weigh in on this at all or should I just keep ranting? Because you should at least be {i}slightly{/i} invested in this as her teacher.
lines.zh: : 你到底要不要发表点意见，还是我就继续这么唠叨下去？好歹你是她的老师，这事你{i}多少{/i}也该上点心吧。

lines.en: : Why...do you think she’s having sex?
lines.zh: : 为什么……你会觉得她在做爱？

lines.en: : Well, between the constant excitement, her better attitude toward me, {i}and the huge box of condoms I found in her room,{/i} I’ve just got a pretty good idea. Call it mother’s intuition.
lines.zh: : 嗯，一方面是她一直兴奋异常，一方面是她对我的态度变好了，{i}再加上我在她房间里翻到的那一大盒避孕套{/i}——我心里就有数了。就叫它母亲的直觉吧。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: : I had no idea she even knew any boys. Like, where would she even find one?
lines.zh: : 我根本不知道她还认识什么男孩子。我是说，她上哪儿去找的？

lines.en: : I have no idea, Maki...
lines.zh: : 我也不知道，Maki……

lines.en: scene makiclearnight4
: Do you get why I’ve been weird lately, now? Or does this still sound all sorts of ridiculous to you? Because it sounds kind of ridiculous to {i}me{/i} and I’m smack-dab in the middle of it.
lines.zh: : 现在你明白我最近为什么怪怪的了吧？还是说这在你听来依然各种荒唐？因为连{i}我{/i}这个深陷其中的人都觉得挺荒唐的。

lines.en: : I...don’t really know how it sounds. And I probably shouldn’t be weighing in on this.
lines.zh: : 我……真说不上来听起来如何。而且我大概也不该对此发表意见。

lines.en: scene makiclearnight5

: That’s it, then? You’re just going to blue ball me in the advice department {i}again{/i} because it makes you uncomfortable? How the hell do you think {i}I{/i} feel? This is my teenage daughter we’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 就这样了？你{i}又{/i}要因为觉得不自在，在给建议这件事上吊着我胃口？那你他妈的觉得{i}我{/i}是什么感受？我们聊的可是我那个青春期的女儿。

lines.en: : Makoto’s smart. You probably don’t need to talk to her about anything if you don’t want to.
lines.zh: : Makoto 很聪明。如果你不想谈，大概也没有什么非谈不可的。

lines.en: : Makoto is smart, yes. But she’s also a {i}child.{/i} And for all we know, there could be some older dude who swooped in to take advantage of her in a time of weakness or something.
lines.zh: : Makoto 是聪明，没错。可她也是个{i}孩子{/i}。而且说不定，真有哪个年纪更大的男人趁虚而入、趁她脆弱的时候占了她的便宜什么的。

lines.en: : That stuff doesn’t just happen in porn, you know. It happens in real life every single day and, most of the time, we have no idea until it’s already too late.
lines.zh: : 这种事可不是只在色情片里才会发生，你知道吗。现实生活里每天都在发生，而且大多数时候，我们等到发现时已经太迟了。

lines.en: What I want to say is that continuing to not do anything is the exact way things become “too late” in the first place...
lines.zh: 我想说的是，一直什么都不做，正是让事情从一开始就变成「太迟了」的原因……

lines.en: But I obviously can’t — because {i}I’m{/i} the man she’s talking about.
lines.zh: 但我显然不能这么说——因为{i}我就是{/i}她所说的那个男人。

lines.en: {i}I’m{/i} the man preying upon her daughter in a time of weakness.
lines.zh: {i}我就是{/i}那个趁她脆弱时觊觎她女儿的男人。

lines.en: {i}I’m{/i} the man leveraging his position and {i}her{/i} affinity for male authority figures for my own personal gain- and the fact that Makoto is magically {i}happy{/i} now doesn’t absolve me of that.
lines.zh: {i}我就是{/i}那个利用自己的立场、利用{i}她{/i}对男性权威形象的依恋来谋取私利的男人——而 Makoto 现在神奇地{i}快乐{/i}起来这一事实，并不能洗刷我的罪。

lines.en: This couldn’t stay hidden forever. Maki was destined to find out the moment she was forced into a more active role in Makoto’s life.
lines.zh: 这事不可能永远藏着。Maki 一旦被迫在 Makoto 的人生里扮演更主动的角色，就注定会发现。

lines.en: But what does that mean for me?
lines.zh: 可这对我意味着什么？

lines.en: Do I have to {i}stop{/i} now?
lines.zh: 我必须现在{i}停手{/i}吗？

lines.en: Do I have to give up on something and {i}someone{/i} I’ve grown so attached to just because her mother is worried?
lines.zh: 就因为她母亲担心了，我就必须放弃我已经如此依恋的某件事、{i}某个人{/i}吗？

lines.en: Can the two of us remain the way we are with Maki indefinitely stuck trying to peer through the brush? Is such a thing possible?
lines.zh: 我们两个还能维持现在这样吗——而 Maki 永远困在灌木丛那头，拼命想看穿过来？这种事有可能吗？

lines.en: Should I just come clean?
lines.zh: 我该干脆坦白吗？

lines.en: No. Fuck no. Of course not. I’m lucky she doesn’t seem to suspect me in the first place.
lines.zh: 不。操，当然不。她还好从一开始就不像在怀疑我，这已经是我的运气了。

lines.en: What should I do?
lines.zh: 我该怎么办？

lines.en: What am I supposed to do?
lines.zh: 我到底该怎么做？

lines.en: How can I get out of this?
lines.zh: 我要怎么脱身？

lines.en: How can I bring myself to care about Maki’s issues when I’m so consumed by my own?
lines.zh: 当我被自己的问题吞噬殆尽时，又怎么能说服自己去在意 Maki 的烦恼？

lines.en: Now, {i}I{/i} am the one rotting from the inside out. How am I supposed to circumvent {i}this?{/i}
lines.zh: 现在，由内而外腐烂的那个人是{i}我{/i}了。我该怎么绕过{i}这个{/i}？

lines.en: : Sensei?...
: Call me Akira.
lines.zh: : 叫我 Akira。

lines.en: scene makiclearnight6
: Akira?...
lines.zh: : Akira？……

lines.en: The answer to my last rhetorical question is the same one I provided just a few short moments ago.
lines.zh: 我上一个反问的答案，和我在片刻之前给出的答案是一样的。

lines.en: I can get around this by disguising myself as someone better.
lines.zh: 我可以把自己伪装成一个更好的人，以此绕开它。

lines.en: I’ll remain disgusting inside of my head- and apply a fresh coat of paint so that those who don’t spend too much time with me mistake me for someone special.
lines.zh: 我的脑子里将一如既往地肮脏——然后再刷上一层新漆，好让那些不常和我相处的人把我错认成某个特别的人。

lines.en: Right now, what I need to do is connect. If I can connect, I can both bring Maki over to my side {i}and{/i} start easing her out of these ridiculous worries of hers.
lines.zh: 眼下我需要做的，是建立连接。只要能连接上，我既能把 Maki 拉到我这边，{i}也{/i}能开始把她从这些荒唐的担忧里慢慢引出来。

lines.en: Makoto is smart.
lines.zh: Makoto 很聪明。

lines.en: It’s just like I said.
lines.zh: 就像我说的那样。

lines.en: She’s smart and she can make her own decisions.
lines.zh: 她很聪明，她能自己做决定。

lines.en: If she wants a thick, adult cock inside of her, she should be allowed to have one. It’s no different from the ones they sell in the store, right?
lines.zh: 如果她想要一根又粗又成熟的鸡巴插进身体里，那就该让她有。这跟商店里卖的那些也没什么不同，对吧？

lines.en: It’s not wrong just because it’s attached to {i}me,{/i} right? I’m better. I’m getting better. I’m not the same person I was when I started doing this. It’s different now.
lines.zh: 不会因为它是长在{i}我{/i}身上就变成错的吧，对吧？我更好了。我正在变好。我已经不是刚开始做这种事时的那个人了。现在不一样了。

lines.en: It’s different now.
lines.zh: 现在不一样了。

lines.en: scene makiclearnight7
: How about “Aki-kun” instead? I like that better.
lines.zh: : 要不换成「Aki 君」？我更喜欢那个。

lines.en: It’s no different now.
lines.zh: 现在其实毫无不同。

lines.en: I’m the same piece of shit I’ve always been.
lines.zh: 我还是那个我一直都是的烂人。

lines.en: And no amount of paint could ever hide that.
lines.zh: 而再多的油漆也遮不住这一点。

lines.en: : That...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: : What’s wrong? Too childish? You embarrassed?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？太幼稚了？你害羞了？

lines.en: : Just...stick with Akira for now.
lines.zh: : 就……暂时还是叫我 Akira 吧。

lines.en: scene makiclearnight8
: ...Okay.

: Don’t think I’ll let you off the hook just because you finally gave me your name, though. I still want to know what you think I should do. Like, what you {i}really{/i} think. Not what you think I want to hear.
lines.zh: : 不过别以为你终于把名字告诉我了，我就会放过你。我还是想知道你觉得我该怎么办。就是，你{i}真正{/i}的想法。不是你觉得我想听的那种。

lines.en: : What if this were Ami we were talking about? What would you say to {i}her{/i} if it started to be clear that she was involved with someone?
lines.zh: : 如果我们聊的是 Ami 呢？如果开始明显看出她跟某个人有牵扯，你会对{i}她{/i}说什么？

lines.en: : I...don’t think I have to worry about that.
lines.zh: : 我……觉得我不用担心那个。

lines.en: : I didn’t think I had to worry about it with Makoto for at least a couple more years, but here we are. Life just moves quicker than we want it to sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我本来以为 Makoto 的事至少还能再过几年才用得上操心，可现在我们不就在这儿了。生活有时候就是比我们想要的走得更快。

lines.en: : In fact, it’s so quick that whatever preparations we make along the way can wind up totally worthless once the ball really gets rolling.
lines.zh: : 事实上，它快到一旦事情真正滚起来，我们一路做下的准备都可能变得一文不值。

lines.en: : I just want her to be safe. Like, safer than condoms — which I am very proud of her for, by the way. But I want her to be so safe that she just doesn’t have sex ever. That would be cool. No sex means no talk.
lines.zh: : 我只是想让她安全。就是，比避孕套更安全的那种——顺便说一句，她会备着避孕套我还挺骄傲的。但我想要她安全到干脆永远都别做爱。那才叫理想。不做爱，就不用谈。

lines.en: : Just have the fucking talk, Maki. It’s better than walking on eggshells every time the subject comes up — which I imagine it does pretty frequently since the two of you work at a porn shop.
lines.zh: : 干脆把那次谈话谈了不就完了，Maki。总好过每次话题一冒出来就如履薄冰——而且我猜这话题还挺常出现的，毕竟你们俩在成人用品店上班。

lines.en: scene makiclearnight9
: But what if she takes it the wrong way? I’m finally on her good side and I don’t want it to seem like I’m overbearing or...anything like that.
lines.zh: : 可万一她误会了呢？我好不容易才站到她好的这一边，我不想让自己显得太强势或者……什么的。

lines.en: : Well, what’s more important to you? Making sure your daughter is safe or making sure she likes you?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得哪个更重要？是确保你女儿安全，还是确保她喜欢你？

lines.en: scene makiclearnight10
: Obviously the first one. I know that. But that doesn’t make it any easier.
lines.zh: : 当然是第一个。这我知道。可这并不代表就容易了。

lines.en: : It’s not supposed to be easy. This is what you signed up for when you carried her around inside of you for nine months.
lines.zh: : 本来就不该容易。当你把她装在肚子里带了九个月的时候，你签下的就是这份合同。

lines.en: scene makiclearnight11
: It was actually ten. That girl did {i}not{/i} want to come out.
lines.zh: : 其实是十个月。那丫头{i}死活不肯{/i}出来。

lines.en: : That is information I did not need or want.
lines.zh: : 这情报我既不需要也不想要。

lines.en: : You’re welcome.
lines.zh: : 不用谢。

lines.en: : Listen, can we head back in now? I’ve exhausted all I have to say about this and if Makoto finds out I was talking to her mom about her sex life, she’s going to stop helping me out after school.
lines.zh: : 听着，我们能回去了吗？这个话题我已经把能说的都说完了——而且要是 Makoto 发现我在跟她妈妈讨论她的性生活，她以后就不会再放学后帮我了。

lines.en: : “Helping you out after school?” You think I haven’t heard that before? Don’t tell me {i}you’re{/i} the one Makoto’s sleeping with, are you?
lines.zh: : 「放学后帮你」？你以为这种说法我没听过？别告诉我，跟 Makoto 上床的就是{i}你{/i}吧？

lines.en: : Maki-
lines.zh: : Maki——

lines.en: scene makiclearnight12
: Relax, Aki...ra. I’m obviously joking.
lines.zh: : 放松，Aki……ra。我显然是在开玩笑。

lines.en: if makisex == True:
: You’re already boning me. Well, when I’m not in desert-mode at least. And you’d be a real idiot to think you can get away with boning my daughter as well.
lines.zh: : 你已经把我睡了。好吧，至少在我没处于「沙漠模式」的时候。而且你要是以为自己睡了我女儿还能全身而退，那可真是蠢到家了。

lines.en: : Especially since she’s only-
lines.zh: : 尤其是她才——

lines.en: : Yeah, I know. You don’t need to remind me.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我知道。你不用提醒我。

lines.en: scene makiclearnight13
: No...but it doesn’t hurt.
lines.zh: : 不……不过也无妨。

lines.en: : Can, uhh...
lines.zh: : 我能，呃……

lines.en: : Can I ask you a personal question? One that {i}doesn’t{/i} really have to do with Makoto?
lines.zh: : 我能问你一个私人问题吗？一个跟 Makoto {i}没什么{/i}关系的？

lines.en: : Please, yes. I’ve been trying to move on from that topic since it came up.
lines.zh: : 拜托，问吧。自从那个话题冒出来，我就一直想翻篇了。

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : You don’t have to answer this if you don’t want to, but...do you think you’ll ever look for something a little more {i}serious?{/i} Romantically, I mean.
lines.zh: : 你不想回答可以不回答，不过……你觉得你以后会去找一段更{i}认真{/i}的关系吗？我是说，恋爱意义上的。

lines.en: : Are you...interested in me like that?
lines.zh: : 你……是对我有那种意思吗？

lines.en: : My husband literally just died.
lines.zh: : 我丈夫才刚死啊。

lines.en: : That’s exactly why I asked. Because if you’re trying to get me to commit to a relationship right now-
lines.zh: : 这正是我问的原因。因为如果你想让我现在就承诺一段关系——

lines.en: : I just...want to know. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是……想知道。就这样。

lines.en: : I like what we have now. But I’d also like knowing if this is all it will ever be or...
lines.zh: : 我喜欢我们现在的样子。但我也想知道，这就是它的全部了，还是……

lines.en: : If there will ever be room to grow.
lines.zh: : 还是说，将来还有成长的空间。

lines.en: : I think we...work kind of well together. And stuff. Whether it be as friends or fuck-buddies or...whatever.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我们……在一起还挺合拍的。什么的。不管是当朋友，还是炮友，还是……随便什么。

lines.en: : It’d just be a little comforting knowing you’re not going anywhere. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 只要知道你不会走，就会让我稍微安心一点。就这些。

lines.en: : I don’t really have anyone else anymore.
lines.zh: : 我已经真的没有别的人了。

lines.en: scene black
: Ask me again when Makoto’s out of high school.
lines.zh: : 等 Makoto 高中毕业了，再问我一次吧。

lines.en: : But if we wait that long, you might start liking her instead! I only have so many years of youthful beauty left!
lines.zh: : 可要是等那么久，说不定你反而会喜欢上她！我青春貌美的年头可剩不了几年了！

lines.en: : I’m going back to the room now, Maki.
lines.zh: : 我现在回房了，Maki。

lines.en: : Ah! Wait, no! You can’t leave without me! You have the key!
lines.zh: : 啊！等等，别！你不能丢下我走！钥匙在你那儿！

lines.en: else:
scene black
: Well, it wasn’t a very good joke...and I’d appreciate it if you didn’t suggest things like that anymore.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那玩笑可不怎么好笑……而且如果你以后别再提这种事，我会很感激的。

lines.en: : No wonder you didn’t want to sleep with me. You already have the younger model.
lines.zh: : 怪不得你不想跟我睡。你已经有了更年轻的那款了。

lines.en: : I’m just going to walk away now.
lines.zh: : 我现在直接走了。

lines.en: : Ah, wait up! I need you to let me back into the room. I didn’t bring my key.
lines.zh: : 啊，等等我！我得让你开门放我回房。我没带钥匙。

lines.en: : You should have thought of that before messing with me.
lines.zh: : 你招惹我之前就该想到这一点。

lines.en: : Akiraaaaaa!
lines.zh: : Akiraaaaa！

lines.en: The two of us make our way back to the room, but I’m slowed down along the way by the weight of a gigantic pit in my stomach.
lines.zh: 我们两个往房间走去，可一路上，胃里那个巨大的坑压得我脚步沉重。

lines.en: As Maki climbs into bed with Haruka and I spread out a futon, that pit expands in size- planting itself into the lining of my organs and sprouting what I can only imagine as the ugliest flowers to ever bloom.
lines.zh: 当 Maki 爬上床和 Haruka 躺在一起、而我铺开一张蒲团时，那个坑扩大了——它扎根进我器官的内壁上，绽出我能想象到的、世上最丑陋的花。

lines.en: As I sleep tonight, I will think of all of the wrong I’ve done.
lines.zh: 今晚入睡时，我会想起我做过的所有错事。

lines.en: My sins will go on to create the longest highlight reel one could imagine and I will watch with bated breath as every single unfortunate segment sinks its nails into my irises.
lines.zh: 我的罪会串联成一卷你能想象到的最长的集锦，而我会屏住呼吸看着其中的每一个不幸片段，把指甲嵌进我的虹膜。

lines.en: And I will do this because there will always be certain aspects of life that just don’t click for us.
lines.zh: 而我会这么做，是因为生活里总有某些面向，是怎么也跟我们对不上频的。

lines.en: For me, the most glaring issue is letting go and accepting just how weak I really am.
lines.zh: 对我来说，最刺眼的问题就是放手，然后接受自己究竟有多软弱。

lines.en: And for Maki, it’s trusting the wrong people.
lines.zh: 而对 Maki 来说，是信任了错的人。

lines.en: She should have never let me into her home.
lines.zh: 她当初就不该让我踏进她的家。

lines.en: And I know that she’ll regret it one day...
lines.zh: 而我知道，总有一天她会后悔的……

lines.en: Because, if she doesn’t-
lines.zh: 因为，如果她不后悔——

lines.en: This was all for nothing.
lines.zh: 这一切就都白费了。

lines.en: I go to sleep.
lines.zh: 我睡去了。

lines.en: And I pause the highlight reel in a room with a deep pink glow.
lines.zh: 而我在一间泛着深粉色光的房间里，按下了那卷集锦的暂停键。
